en.headline: Woman left unconscious after concrete mixer hits pedestrian in Kam Tin
en.dek: Police said a heavy vehicle carrying concrete struck a woman on a crossing along Kam Tin Road near 8.30am; she was taken to Pok Oi Hospital.
body: A woman was left unconscious on Wednesday morning after being hit by a concrete mixer truck on Kam Tin Road in Pat Heung, Yuen Long, local media reported, citing police.

The collision was reported at about 8.31am near a pedestrian crossing by Ko Po Tsuen, close to the junction with Tsing Long Highway. The truck had been travelling along the slow lane towards Pat Heung when it struck the woman as she crossed, according to accounts given at the scene.

Ambulance crews took the injured woman to Pok Oi Hospital. The driver remained to assist the investigation. One shoe was left at the crossing. Police said they were examining how the collision happened.

The driver told officers the vehicle had a green light and that the pedestrian stepped out from the right, according to reports. Police have not released the woman's identity or a formal finding on fault.

zh.headline: 錦田公路混凝土車撞女途人 傷者昏迷送博愛醫院
zh.dek: 今早約8時半，一輛運載混凝土的重型貨車在八鄉錦田公路近高埔村行人過路處撞到一名女子，司機在場助查。
body: 元朗八鄉錦田公路周三早上發生交通意外，一名女子被運載混凝土的重型貨車撞倒後昏迷，由救護車送往博愛醫院搶救。
本地媒體引述警方消息指，意外約於8時31分發生，事發地點為錦田公路近高埔村行人過路處、靠近青朗公路交界。貨車當時沿慢線往八鄉方向行駛。
司機在場協助調查。現場遺下一隻鞋。警方正調查意外原因，暫未公布傷者身分及正式責任劃分。
據現場報道，司機向警員表示當時沿綠燈行駛，途人由右至左步出過路處。調查仍在進行。
